summary: {member} asks who can pay for a hearing aid after the committee hears who may sell it.
realLife: Commenters raised Medicare coverage and asked about insurance payments or incentives. FDA answered that it lacked power to make insurers reimburse buyers through this rule. In its February 2024 coverage comparison, GAO found that traditional Medicare covered neither category of hearing aid. VA officials told GAO that their contracts generally made prescription aids cheaper for the agency than buying retail aids.
inGame: needs: device coverage decisions and payer jurisdiction.

turns.pulledBy: A constituent brings an insurance denial.
turns.what: The caseworker checks who issued the coverage decision.
turns.writesBack: Staff sends the payment question to the office responsible for coverage.
